title: Hinamatsuri Explained: A Guide to Japan's Doll Festival (Girls' Day) / ひなまつり
description: A comprehensive cultural explainer about Hinamatsuri (Girls' Day, March 3rd), a traditional Japanese festival celebrating girls. Covers the history of the doll festival, the hierarchical display of hina-ningyō (decorative dolls representing the imperial court), the symbolism of peach blossoms (momo no sekku), and the traditional foods associated with the celebration including chirashi-zushi and hina-arare candies. Includes visuals of elaborate hina displays and explanations of the multi-tiered structure.
